card.name: HLA allele names and lymphocyte count values
card.fires_on: The hyphen, letter B, or digit inside HLA allele names such as HLA-B*5701, HLA-B*1502 and HLA-A*02:01, in screening or genotype statements. It also fires on the space before a lymphocyte count threshold.
